abstract: INTRODUCTION: Bulky dermoid cysts of the floor of the mouth are very rare and may pose a problem of diagnosis. They also raise problems for the anesthesiologist and surgeon. We report the first case to be described in Togo. CASE REPORT: A 23-year-old man was admitted for a submental submandibular sublingual mass. It was soft, depressable, painless, without adenopathies, raising the tongue against the palate and creating a "second tongue-like" aspect. Resection on intra-oral route removed an intact cyst of 13cm long axis. Histology diagnosed dermoid cyst. DISCUSSION: Dermoid cysts of the floor of the mouth present as a submental sublingual mass, which may cause dyspnea and disorders of swallowing, chewing and/or vocal function. Differential diagnosis concerns sublingual, submental and cervical masses. Definitive diagnosis is founded on the histology specimen. Imaging may assist diagnosis. Intubation may be problematic. The resection approach may be intra-oral or cervical. CONCLUSION: Dermoid cysts of the floor of the mouth are rare. They may induce functional disorder. An intra-oral approach is preferable when possible.
abstract_ja: 【緒言】口腔底の巨大類皮嚢腫は稀であり、診断上の問題を提起する可能性があり、麻酔科医および外科医にとって問題を引き起こす。トーゴで報告される最初の症例を報告。【症例報告】23歳男性が上頸部下顎骨下舌下腫瘤で入院。軟性で圧迫可能、無痛、リンパ節腫脹なく、舌を口蓋に持ち上げ『第二の舌様』外観を呈。経口的切除によって13cm長軸の無傷嚢腫を摘除。【考察】口腔底の類皮嚢腫は上頸部舌下腫瘤として発症し、呼吸困難および嚥下機能障害を引き起こす可能性。【結論】口腔底の類皮嚢腫は稀であり、機能的障害を引き起こす可能性。可能な場合は経口的アプローチが推奨。
